sentences.text: My lantern watched the living room, and I noticed the temperature stayed below 18.0 °C between 02:30 and 06:00.
The coldest time was 05:40, when the temperature reached 17.4 °C.
Since the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, this is something to note.
Perhaps checking the heating system would be a gentle idea to keep the house warm.
